Help Charen find his lost love Kwalanah.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Search [[the Ruptured Heart]] for anyone who might know the whereabouts of [[Kwalanah]].
* See [[Charen]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Ancient Artifact]]

==Walkthrough==
After receiving the quest, head west past the small strip of sulfurous sands to find [[Jehner]]. Speak to Jehner and return to Charen for your reward.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Human]]s
*{{x}} 20 [[Jehner]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Charen
:''"My sweet Kwalanah...I'm afraid she has done something terribly foolish.  I told her it was a preposterous notion but she wouldn't listen to me.  Reborn?  Bah!  We have been quite content with the way things are for a very long time.   But she's impressionable, and I fear that even in death she's fallen in with the wrong sort.''

:''She has gone missing, you see, and I can't find her anywhere.  Please, will you search the area and help me find her?  I do not want to spend eternity without her."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I shall not rest until I reacquaint you with your love.
|decline = If you love someone set them free.
|ask = Someone around here must know where my sweet '''Kwalanah''' went. Please continue your search. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Jehner
:''"Kwalanah?  I have not seen her in some time.  But I may know what ill has befallen her by the hands of the Margonites.''

:''Their ploy is simple: to convince discontented souls to be "reborn" through a suspicious ritual that allegedly binds spirits to flesh.  In actuallity,  the Margonites seek to consume the souls of the departed.  Kwalanah should have accepted her fate rather than deny it.  She may be lost forever."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Charen
:''"This is terrible!  My dear, sweet Kwalanah!''
:''Thank you for delivering this news, no matter how grim.  There is more to do.  I only hope my wife is not gone forever"''

===Notes===
{{Bug|Occasionally, [[Charen]] will not give the reward for this quest. When this happens, you have to exit to an outpost, abandon the quest and  and return to the area to restart}}
